items.text: Let it be — I checked the log and every piece shipped an hour ago worked on first contact: `climb` carried him up, the keeper answered, the trade took his spoon and gave him the flask. Only wrinkle is that "give bone" fired the spoon trade (the loose trigger I flagged), which is a build-turn fix, not worth a voice from the air while he's up there talking to her.
